Oowlish, one of Latin America’s rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking an experienced technology professional to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work‑life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We’re looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

We’re partnering with an innovative early‑stage company revolutionizing pet health through smart, connected technology. Their product is a next‑generation collar‑mounted device that leverages IoT and AI to monitor pet activity, wellness, and location in real‑time — helping both pet parents and veterinarians take proactive care decisions.

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer to join our Firmware team. If you’re passionate about low‑level development and excited to shape the future of pet tech, this role is for you.

  • 3+ years experience with LTE‑M/NB‑IoT modules from Quectel and U‑blox/Trasna
  • Experience optimizing for different power optimizations like PSM and eDRX
  • Experience with IoT protocols over LTE‑M (MQTT, CoAP, HTTP and LwM2M)

Nice to Have

  • Experience with other common MCUs (STM32, NXP LPC, PIC, AVR)
  • Experience with GNSS technologies
  • Experience with MEMS‑based sensing technologies

title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
description:
About Us

At MetaCTO, we specialize in helping startups and growing companies turn visionary ideas into successful digital products through expert app development and fractional CTO services. As a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), you will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of the backend infrastructure that powers innovative applications for our clients. This role will involve managing cloud environments, optimizing databases, automating deployments, and improving system observability.

Job Description

As a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at MetaCTO, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining highly available, scalable, and secure infrastructure solutions. You will collaborate with software engineers to improve system performance, automate operations, and ensure the smooth functioning of critical backend services. You’ll work extensively with cloud platforms like AWS, leveraging technologies such as Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI / CD pipelines to enhance system reliability.

Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure on AWS (Lambda, EC2, RDS, S3, EKS, SQS, CloudWatch).
  • Manage and optimize databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) for performance, reliability, and security.
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions to ensure system health and performance, with specific experience using Zabbix and Elastic Logging.
  • Design and maintain CI / CD pipelines for automated deployment and scaling of applications.
  • Work with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Develop and enforce security best practices for cloud environments and infrastructure.
  • Automate operational processes using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and scripting languages like Python or Bash.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure-related incidents and optimize system performance.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and scalable system design, with a strong focus on Django-based applications.

Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us but with a different name : Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group (

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves : is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted : treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you : wanna join us in the next step helping people live longer and healthier lives?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health-tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top-tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end-to-end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high-quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 50 million patients trust us every month. 300.000+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 12 years ago.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different : we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote-friendly.

Remote model : you can work 100% from home, but you are also welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro.

Feegow is the leading Practice Management System (PMS) in Brazil for individual doctors & large clinics alike, and a highly strategic product for Docplanner Group, as a foundation to conquer the Brazilian market.

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Director of Product for Feegow to lead our product teams, drive innovation, accountability, and play a key role in our product's modernization. This is a remote-friendly role within Brazil, where you’ll foster collaboration between global teams, steer product development, and manage a talented product team. Your expertise in building a data-driven & business minded product culture whilst delivering fast & safe iterations, knowing when to go for PoCs & robust solutions based on the business appetite and product maturity will ensure the continued growth of Feegow and Docplanner Group.

What we expect from this position :

Inspire, lead and bring in PMS product vision to all product managers and teams.

Understand a complex environment where the teams have not only individual doctors and clinics that should be delighted with their Efficiency platform, whilst bringing them new value propositions like Visibility & Growth, as well as betting on AI as a door opener for exponential value.

Define with PMs the product strategy on every team, how it relates to the broader Brazilian strategy & Docplanner Tech & Product strategy.

Influence and establish a shared vision with other business areas as Sales, Operations and Marketing. Be a key stakeholder for Individuals and Clinics Business owners.

Ensure upcoming product needs and opportunities aligned with your Engineering Director and Country Managers to create a coherent Product & Tech Strategy and Roadmap.

Champion a hands‑on approach to innovation by using a combination of Data, listening to the market, and “getting out of the building” to get first‑hand customer / user insights.

Create a culture of decision‑making based on insight, analysis and data across the business.

Work closely with our Global VP Product, on standardizing the objectives in clear indicators & tasks and bring transparency on ‘the plan’ across the whole company.

Minimum 3 years’ work experience as Product Director / GPM (managing and coaching a group of Product Managers)

Experience on B2B SaaS scale‑ups

Solid experience in fast high-growth environment, change management, & business growth

An entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding organizational, communicative and leadership skills

Business savvy, holistic business acumen outside of Product Management and ability to assess product market fit

About The Project

We’re supporting a US homeowner who wants to redesign and expand their existing home. The project includes modifying current layouts, extending structural areas, adding new rooms, adjusting rooflines, and producing 2D/3D plans to visualize the new design before submission to a US-licensed professional. We do not require a US-licensed architect. Your job is to redesign, model, and prepare architectural drawings, and later a Texas‑licensed professional will take those drawings and submit them for permitting.

Role Summary

You will take the homeowner’s ideas (videos, measurements, sketches, existing blueprints) and convert them into professional architectural redesigns. Your deliverables will include updated floor plans, elevations, sections, and 3D models that clearly show how the redesigned spaces will look and function. The Texas‑licensed engineer/architect will later use your plans for code compliance, stamping, and permitting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review existing layout and homeowner‑provided videos describing the redesign vision.
  • Redesign interior and exterior spaces, including:
    • Third‑floor addition with bedroom + bathroom
    • Roofline extension and possible dormers
    • Second‑floor bedroom + full bath redesign
    • Expanded deck and "bonus room" concepts
    • Sunroom / screened‑in patio addition with proper roofing
    • Semi‑open courtyard area with beams/pergola elements
  • Produce updated architectural drawings:
    • Floor plans
    • Roof plans
    • Elevations

Sobre a Organização

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.
Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.
O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.
Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

title: Senior Partnership Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has created a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Senior Partnership Manager will be responsible for managing and delivering FIFA’s commercial partner rights at the local level, ensuring seamless coordination with the global FIFA Partnership Management team in Zurich. This includes day-to-day relationship management, operational delivery at venues and events where required, and strategic alignment with partner objectives within the host country and region.

Key responsibilities

  • Proactively lead and foster relationships with FIFA Commercial Partners operating in Brazil, ensuring consistent, high-quality servicing in line with global standards.
  • Act as the key local point of contact for assigned Commercial Partner, ensuring continuous alignment and close collaboration with the Partnership Management team at FIFA Zurich to maintain consistent servicing and delivery across all touchpoints.
  • Lead assigned partnership projects and deliverables related to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ in Brazil, ensuring on-time, in-scope, and on-budget execution while identifying meaningful, locally relevant business and marketing opportunities that enhance partner impact and remain aligned with FIFA’s global partnership and brand strategy.
  • Project lead for assigned local partner activations and FIFA-related events in Brazil (e.g. Local Commercial Partner Workshops).
  • Ensure local partner activations and brand visibility adhere to FIFA’s third‑party regulations and brand protection standards, working in close coordination with the Commercial Legal and Brand teams.
  • Track and manage local partner budgets and support reconciliation processes in close coordination with the Zurich Partnerships team.
  • Prepare and lead meetings and updates with internal and external stakeholders, including regular reporting to the Partnership Management team at FIFA Zurich.
  • Provide solution‑oriented, proactive support to the Head of Commercial Partnerships in Brazil and contribute to a unified servicing approach across global and local workstreams.
  • Support continuous improvement by feeding local market insights and operational learnings into FIFA’s global partnership tools and client servicing frameworks.

Your profile

  • University degree required, preferably in Business, Marketing, Sports Management, or a related field
  • A solid understanding of the business of sports, marketing, and sponsorship rights delivery
  • Project and event management experience, ideally in an international environment
  • Working knowledge of digital and social media is an advantage
  • 6–8 years of experience in brand marketing, sponsorship, or client servicing in the sports or entertainment industry
  • Proven track record of managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders
  • Experience working in or with international organizations and global brands
  • Familiarity with the Brazilian market and local executional landscape is a strong asset
  • Client-oriented with strong interpersonal and written communication skills
  • Efficient and effective time management and organizational skills
  • Ability to define priorities, lead projects independently, and provide direction to junior team members when required
  • Team-oriented, service-minded, and collaborative across functions
  • Strategic and creative problem‑solver with a hands‑on mindset
  • Comfortable working under pressure, managing multiple priorities and deadlines
  • Strong sense of ownership, initiative, and accountability
  • High level of professionalism, empathy, and commercial awareness
  • Strong representation skills, both internally and externally
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Job Purpose

About Us: At TechnipFMC, within the Controls & Automation product line, we are pioneering technology platforms for the electrification of Subsea Control Systems and the advancement of renewable energy sources such as offshore wind, hydrogen, and wave energy.

Our Team: The Electronics R&D team works across a broad spectrum of technologies, including analog electronics, FPGA, SoC, power design, safety design, motor controllers, processor design, and power line modems. These technologies are integral to various control system applications.

Your Role: As part of the Controls & Automation team at TechnipFMC, you will engage in the design, development, qualification, system integration, and production of new products, from commissioning to field operation. Our multidisciplinary development environment includes HW, SW, system, test, mechatronics, and production engineering teams working collaboratively.

We are seeking Senior Power Electronics Developers with expertise in motor control and battery management systems to join our Hardware development team.

Job Description

  • Define hardware requirements in collaboration with system, drive train, and battery management system architects and developers.
  • Design and develop motor drive and battery management circuits, PCBAs, and modules, including component selection, schematic drawing, PCB layout, and prototype building.
  • Conduct functional verification of motor drive and battery management system circuits, PCBAs, sub-assemblies, and electrical actuators.
  • Collaborate with systems architects, mechanical designers, PCB layout, manufacturing, reliability, and SW engineering teams to design and develop power electronics products.
  • Create test procedures and write test reports on functional, environmental, system operation mode, and manufacturing testing of custom power electronic designs.

You are meant for this job if:

  • Analog electronics, including discrete design with Opamps, transistors, inductors, transformers, and capacitors for high voltage designs.
  • Component selection of high voltage power semiconductors (IGBTs, MOSFETs, diodes) for gate drives and analog/digital measurement circuits.
  • Power electronics design across various topologies in the AC or DC domain for motor controllers, battery management circuits, power supplies, and switches.
  • Schematic design and PCB layout using ECAD tools like Altium Designer or equivalent.
  • Knowledge of motor drive and battery control topologies, semiconductor component performance, and loss mechanisms.
  • Experience with lab instruments such as oscilloscopes, network analyzers, signal generators, programmable loads, motor, and battery simulators.
  • Expertise in PCB layout for optimal component placement, reduced stray inductance/capacitance, improved manufacturability, and EMC compliance.
  • Knowledge of control algorithms and embedded programming for circuit design verification.
  • Experience in power electronics design optimized for DFX requirements (manufacturability and testability).
  • Understanding of EMC requirements and CE certification relevant to motor controller design in control system applications.

Qualifications:

  • BSc, MSc, or PhD in electronics, automation, cybernetics, or a related engineering field.
  • 3-5 years of industrial experience in relevant power electronics development and industrialization.
  • Ability to approach complex problems structurally.
  • Open-minded, professional English proficiency, and adaptability to work in a multicultural environment.
  • Continuously raising standards, innovative, and solution oriented.
  • Interest in electronics is an additional advantage.

What We Offer:

  • Engaging tasks and work-life balance.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Training and career development opportunities.
  • Comprehensive insurance and pension plans.

title: Engineer Who Can Design - Americas
description:
Engineer Who Can Design - Americas

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

This range is provided by Ashby. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

Base pay range

$153,000.00/yr - $220,000.00/yr

Hi I’m Abhik, Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. As someone who could design and build software, this position is close to my heart. I always felt I had a unique perspective because I could play with design ideas and iterate in code. My ideas could start in Figma but then be grounded (or sometimes more creative) in code. My prototypes used actual logic and data. My changes cascaded throughout the app for comprehensive critique (thanks, React component system!). But, every company made me pick one— I couldn’t design and build. At Ashby, you can.

While Every Engineer Can Design And Build, You’ll Tackle Our Most Challenging Design Problems And Help Others Improve Their Designs By Expanding And Enhancing Our In-house Design System And Consulting On Bespoke Work. To Ground It With Examples, Engineers Who Can Design At Ashby Have

  • Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using it to make the wireframes a reality.
  • Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build custom autocompletes. These autocompletes can contain filters, options to create new records, etc.
  • Helped another engineer improve their design's information hierarchy and scannability for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies.

These projects reflect what we’re accomplishing at Ashby: improving the productivity of working professionals (starting with talent teams) with intelligent and powerful software. We put a lot of effort into designing products that are approachable to beginners but mastered & extended by power users. In many ways, spreadsheets set the bar here.

We have many customers, great revenue growth, years of runway, and amazing investors like YCombinator, Elad Gil, and Lachy Groom. I’ll share more once we meet.

This is a staff-level role, so we require at least 5 years of experience as a full-time frontend engineer or evenly split between frontend and design for this role and significant contributions to (or leading) design systems.

Engineering Culture

Our engineering culture is motivated by Benji’s (my co-founder and CEO) and my belief that a small talented team, given the right environment, can build high-quality software fast (and work regular hours!).

Collaboration is Natural & Communication is Deliberate. Our engineering team (and the team at large) consists of lifelong learners who are humble and kind (meet them here!). These attributes create an environment where collaboration happens naturally (we filter for it in interviews). We combine this with research, prototyping, and written proposals to see around corners and get feedback from the team across time zones. Focus time is something that we hold sacred, and, with thoughtful and deliberate communication, engineers spend less than 4 hours per week in meetings (I wrote about it here).

Increase Leverage, not Team Size. We Built Ashby With The Quality, Breadth, And Depth That Many Customers Would Expect From Much Larger Teams Over Larger Time Scales. We’ve Done This Through Investment In

  • Great developer tooling. Our CI/CD takes ~10m, and we deploy at least 10x a day. Everyone on the team has contributed to developer experience
  • Building blocks to create powerful and customizable products fast. At the core of Ashby is a set of common components (analytics modeling and query language, policy engine, workflow engine, design system) which we are constantly improving. Each improvement to a common component cascades throughout our app.

And a Demo Of One Of These Building Blocks. Here’s an impromptu quote from Arjun in our company Slack of what it’s like to build a feature at Ashby.

Give Engineers Ownership & Autonomy. We, as engineers, find clever ways to solve problems, which amplifies when we deeply understand the problem. Benji and I did our best work as engineers when we had a deep understanding of the end-user and the business and ownership over the solution. Our engineering culture reflects this experience: engineers own projects end-to-end, from speaking with users to writing product specs to UX design. These are skills that we often don’t get to practice as engineers, and, at Ashby, we provide mentorship to grow them and help from the team where you want it.

Put Effort into Diversity. Diverse teams drive innovation and better outcomes. Having seen my mother and partner build their careers as minority women in non-diverse fields, I want to make sure Ashby creates opportunities for the next generation of engineers from underrepresented groups (including my daughter!). Today, 26% of engineers at Ashby are from underrepresented groups. It’s not great, and we are taking conscious steps to improve, like sourcing diverse candidates, providing generous paid family leave, no leetcode interviews, and more.

Interview Process

At Ashby, Our Team And Interview Process Want To Help You Show Your Best Self. We’ll Dive Into Past Projects And Simulate Working Together Via Pair Programming, Writing Tech Specs Collaboratively, And Talking Through Decisions (no Leetcode Or Whiteboard Exercises). Our Interview Process Is Three Rounds With Some Casual Zoom (or In-person) Coffee In Between To Get To Know Each Other

  • 30-minute introduction call to discuss Ashby and your past work (we demo Ashby!)
  • A technical screen (take home or, for more experienced folks who want it, a 90-minute live session)
  • A virtual on-site of 3 hours and 45 minutes (can be split across two days)

Your hiring manager will be your main point of contact and prepare you for interviews. You’ll meet other engineering leaders and 4 to 6 engineers (with 15 minutes in each interview to ask them questions). If we don’t give an offer, we’ll provide feedback!

Your First Two Months at Ashby

We want an exceptional onboarding experience for every new hire. At Ashby, your dev environment sets up with a single script, you push your first change on day one, and we spend the rest of the time building your confidence in our codebase and practices culminating in delivering a prominent, impactful feature. We’ll pair you with a peer who’ll guide you through your first tasks and be someone you rely on, from answering questions to pair programming.

Technology Stack

Our tech stack is TypeScript (frontend & backend), React, a mix of SASS modules and Stitches, Apollo GraphQL, Node.js, Postgres, and Redis. We're looking for folks with deep React, CSS, and HTML knowledge for this role.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity.
  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby — do it when you feel financially comfortable.
  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one‑on‑one agenda until you start taking it

title: Engineer II
description:
Join to apply for the Engineer II role at ABS Group

Job Description

Performs engineering design review and analysis assignments normally involving a major project or several smaller or less complex projects. These projects, by their complexity and difficulty, require the competent application of mechanical engineering knowledge and conventional engineering practices. The incumbent will develop a strong understanding of company policies, methods, and procedures through broader and technically challenging assignments.

What You Will Do

  • With minimal or no supervision performs detailed engineering review of plans, as assigned, for compliance with applicable Rules, Regulations and contract commitments.
  • Perform detailed engineering review of mechanical systems and designs for compliance with applicable international standards, Brazilian NRs, local authority requirements, and ABS Group methodologies.
  • Conduct inspections and Risk-Based Inspection (RBI) for piping, pressure vessels, and pressure valves, considering API 579 Fitness-for-Service analysis and other regulatory standards.
  • Provide support and technical solutions for Marine and Offshore assets and refinery facilities.
  • Analyze and resolve design conflicts and propose innovative solutions to moderately complex engineering problems.
  • Draft accurate and timely technical reports, responses to communications, and formal documentation.
  • Communicate project status and workload effectively to ensure client needs are met.
  • Work independently or in a team environment and interact with clients to identify and resolve technical challenges.
  • Implement and maintain ABS Group Quality System requirements after completing Quality System training.

What You Will Need

Education and Experience

  • B.S. degree in Mechanical Engineering or another related discipline.
  • Professional/Chartered Engineer License.
  • Certification as Person Habilitated (PH) in Brazil under CREA standards.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Demonstrated understanding and ability to apply fundamental classification and quality concepts, practices and procedures.
  • Demonstrated understanding and ability to apply advanced mechanical engineering concepts, practices, and standards.
  • Knowledge of Risk-Based Inspection (RBI) techniques, including API 579 Fitness-for-Service analysis.
  • Proficiency in CAESAR II (pipe stress analysis) and familiarity with Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) tools is advantageous.
  • Solid problem-solving skills with the ability to propose technical solutions to engineering challenges.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work well independently or collaboratively with others in a team.
  • Strong computer literacy, including the use of engineering analysis software.
  • Five (5) years minimum of relevant mechanical engineering experience in a design office, consulting company, or energy industry-related projects.

It Would Be Nice If You Had

Professional or chartered engineer license.

Reporting Relationships

The incumbent reports to a senior level engineer or technical manager. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

  • Project Management: Serve as the main point of contact for stakeholders, SMEs, and clients, ensuring clear communication and alignment of expectations.
  • Project Management: Monitor project risks, dependencies, and quality assurance processes.
  • Project Management: Drive continuous improvement in instructional design processes and project management practices.
  • Project Management: The confidence to balance competing priorities, and maintain high standards in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

  • Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and organisational skills.
  • Fluency in both Brazilian Portuguese and English, with the ability to adapt learning and communication styles to ensure training is relevant and accessible to both local and international audiences.

Somos mais de 4.000 profissionais em 11 países, com uma cultura multicultural e de startup, na qual cultivamos a inovação e o aprendizado contínuo para criar soluções de alto valor para nossos clientes.

Localidade: Rio de Janeiro - Centro

Modelo de atuação: Presencial

Formato de contratação: CLT ou PJ

Descrição do Cargo

Estamos em busca de um PMO Pleno para atuar como pilar estrutural da governança, garantindo cadência, integridade metodológica, organização documental e consistência no acompanhamento dos workstreams. Esse profissional será essencial para sustentar a execução integrada dos projetos de Backoffice, IS-U, Dados, Integrações e Cutover.

Responsabilidades

  • Controlar e atualizar cronogramas integrados, garantindo aderência entre todos os workstreams.
  • Monitorar entregáveis, pendências, riscos, issues, dependências e planos de ação.
  • Elaborar reports semanais e mensais: status report, dashboards, KPIs, burn-up/down e análises de impacto.
  • Apoiar a operação da governança executiva: Steering, PMO Board, Risk Board e Architecture Board.
  • Documentar com precisão atas, decisões, follow-ups e encaminhamentos.
  • Manter a organização documental em Confluence/SharePoint, assegurando datas, versionamento e compliance metodológico.
  • Acompanhar a aderência das equipes ao SAP Activate, garantindo consistência entre fases, gates e marcos.
  • Suportar readiness de testes, mock, UAT, cutover e go-live.
  • Integrar informações entre Backoffice, IS-U, integrações, dados e Cutover, consolidando visão única do programa.
  • Interagir com fornecedores, áreas de negócio e TI para garantir ritmo de execução e alinhamento geral.

Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia como PMO em projetos de ERP, tecnologia ou transformação digital.
  • Vivência em ambientes SAP (S/4HANA, ECC ou IS-U).
  • Excel avançado e domínio de ferramentas de PMO (MS Project, Jira, Confluence, Power BI).
  • Disciplina organizacional e capacidade de operar com grande volume de informação.
  • Inglês intermediário para reportes, documentação e interfaces pontuais com fornecedores.
  • Mindset colaborativo, ownership e atenção extrema ao detalhe.
  • Capacidade de transformar informação dispersa em inteligência organizada para tomada de decisão.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em Utilities/Energia ou outros setores regulados.
  • Familiaridade com SAP Activate, PMI ou frameworks similares.
  • Vivência em programas de alta complexidade, com múltiplos fornecedores e integrações críticas.
  • Experiência com governança executiva e gestão de riscos estruturada.

title: Partnership Business Development Executive
description:
ABOUT US

Chiliz - the world’s leading sports-focused blockchain Tech company, is leading the charge into Web3, building a global ecosystem where fans don’t just watch the game, they become a part of it. If you’re ready to put on your jersey and get to work alongside a dynamic global team, this could be the perfect match.

OUR BRANDS

  • Chiliz: The backbone of our ecosystem, creator of Chiliz Chain - the Layer 1 blockchain that powers our vision of Web3 for sports and entertainment.
  • Fan Tokens: Official Digital Assets for more than 70 of the world’s biggest sports teams, including giants like Paris Saint Germain, Man City, FC Barcelona.
  • Socios.com: The Web3 Fan Token Wallet and home of Fan Token rewards.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a self-starter with exceptional business acumen who can navigate complex stakeholder environments. You should be comfortable operating independently while collaborating across teams, possess strong analytical capabilities, and demonstrate genuine enthusiasm for the intersection of sports, technology, and finance. Your ability to identify creative partnership opportunities and execute them will be critical to success in this role.

Due to the global scope of Chiliz, this role requires fluency in both English and Portuguese. Please submit your CV In English.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Identify, evaluate, and develop strategic partnerships with retail networks, financial institutions, investment firms, and other potential distribution channels for fan tokens and Chiliz products
  • Build and maintain relationships with key decision-makers across banking, sports organizations, and crypto-related businesses in Brazil
  • Create compelling business proposals, pitch decks, and partnership frameworks tailored to prospective partners' needs and objectives
  • Conduct market analysis to identify emerging opportunities and competitive dynamics in the Brazilian digital asset and sports engagement landscape
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful partnership implementation and ongoing relationship management
  • Represent Socios.com/Chiliz at industry events, conferences, and client meetings
  • Track partnership performance metrics and provide regular reports on business development activities and pipeline status

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in business development, sales, or partnerships, preferably within the financial services/banking sector. Preferably knowledge of web3, and could be sports related.
  • Proven track record of successfully closing complex B2B partnerships and achieving revenue targets
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian financial services landscape and regulatory environment
  • Excellent presentation and negotiation skills with ability to influence C-level executives
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (written and verbal)
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or related field
  • Preferred Qualifications
  • Direct experience or demonstrated interest in sports industry partnerships and sponsorships
  • Knowledge of cryptocurrency, blockchain technology, and digital asset markets
  • Existing network within Brazilian banking, retail, or investment sectors
  • Experience drafting commercial agreements and partnership terms

WHAT WE OFFER

The chance to join a global community of sports blockchain enthusiasts spanning 6 countries and over 40 nationalities, committed to building a vibrant, exciting Web3 future for sports alongside some of the biggest names on the planet. We’re looking for team players who are happy to try, fail, and bounce back because a great team is all about the comeback.

We believe the interview process is a two-way street. Think of it as a draft where we're both trying to make the best pick. Our competitive salaries, wellness allowance, healthcare, and pension plans are just the tip of the iceberg. You’ll be joining a diverse, global team, where flexibility and challenge are part of the playbook.

Ready to play? Let’s get to work.

description:
What We Offer

Work From Anywhere – 100% remote opportunity with a results-driven global team.

Proven System For Success – No more hitting and hoping. Our battle-tested Google Ads system generates high-quality leads with consistency so you can focus on precision execution and campaign optimization.

Career Development Opportunities – For high performers, there is opportunity to grow into system-building and high-level strategy roles over time.

High-Impact Role – See your work drive results with granular execution and proactive communication.

Elite Team Culture – Join a group of specialists who prioritize precision, data, and high performance.

Paid Time Off As Needed – Take well-deserved breaks whenever you need them.

Who We Are

Pressure Washing Marketing Pros is a digital marketing agency focused on Google Ads, SEO, and high-converting web design for exterior cleaning companies. By focusing on this niche, we’ve discovered and scaled on repeatable processes that allow us to :

Execute based on data and beat “seat of the pants” traditional strategies.

Deliver predictable, high-quality leads with our proven Google Ads system.

Scale results by constantly testing, refining, and optimizing our paid campaigns.

Our speed, output, and constant improvement help set us apart from our competition.

Your Role & Impact

As a Google Ads Specialist on our team, you’ll execute and optimize campaigns across 70+ Google Ads accounts and 25+ Local Service Ads accounts. You’ll join our existing Google Ads Manager and Google Ads Specialist who have been with the company for years and who are experts with our system. You and the current Specialist will follow our framework, while proactively collaborating with our SEO and client success teams to ensure campaigns are always in-line with overall business goals.

Key Responsibilities

Build campaigns in Google Ads Manager and Ads Editor following our templates and SOPs.

Perform weekly and monthly optimization routines (negative keywords, search term reviews, budgets, ad assets, keyword additions, bidding strategy, etc. ).

Run through QA checklist before launching or editing a campaign (geo settings, match types, naming conventions, conversion actions, etc. ).

Maintain documentation and task updates in ClickUp.

Implement and QA tracking with WhatConverts following established processes.

Run reports in Looker Studio with performance analysis.

Manage Local Service Ads (budget pacing, category, verification checks, etc. ).

Proactively collaborate with SEO and client success managers to align campaign performance with business goals.

Identify areas of improvement to our SOPs based on test results or recurring events.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

Minimum of 2 years experience managing Google Ads campaigns for lead generation (non-ecommerce).

Track record of precision execution and zero critical errors in recent work.

title: Power Electronics Developer
description:
Job Purpose

About Us: At TechnipFMC, within the Controls & Automation product line, we are pioneering technology platforms for the electrification of Subsea Control Systems and the advancement of renewable energy sources such as offshore wind, hydrogen, and wave energy.

Our Team: The Electronics R&D team works across a broad spectrum of technologies, including analog electronics, FPGA, SoC, power design, safety design, motor controllers, processor design, and power line modems. These technologies are integral to various control system applications.

Your Role: As part of the Controls & Automation team at TechnipFMC, you will engage in the design, development, qualification, system integration, and production of new products, from commissioning to field operation. Our multidisciplinary development environment includes HW, SW, system, test, mechatronics, and production engineering teams working collaboratively.

We are seeking Senior Power Electronics Developers with expertise in motor control and battery management systems to join our Hardware development team.

Job Description
  • Define hardware requirements in collaboration with system, drive train, and battery management system architects and developers.
  • Design and develop motor drive and battery management circuits, PCBAs, and modules, including component selection, schematic drawing, PCB layout, and prototype building.
  • Conduct functional verification of motor drive and battery management system circuits, PCBAs, sub-assemblies, and electrical actuators.
  • Collaborate with systems architects, mechanical designers, PCB layout, manufacturing, reliability, and SW engineering teams to design and develop power electronics products.
  • Create test procedures and write test reports on functional, environmental, system operation mode, and manufacturing testing of custom power electronic designs.
You are meant for this job if:
  • Analog electronics, including discrete design with Opamps, transistors, inductors, transformers, and capacitors for high voltage designs.
  • Component selection of high voltage power semiconductors (IGBTs, MOSFETs, diodes) for gate drives and analog/digital measurement circuits.
  • Power electronics design across various topologies in the AC or DC domain for motor controllers, battery management circuits, power supplies, and switches.
  • Schematic design and PCB layout using ECAD tools like Altium Designer or equivalent.
  • Knowledge of motor drive and battery control topologies, semiconductor component performance, and loss mechanisms.
  • Experience with lab instruments such as oscilloscopes, network analyzers, signal generators, programmable loads, motor, and battery simulators.
  • Expertise in PCB layout for optimal component placement, reduced stray inductance/capacitance, improved manufacturability, and EMC compliance.
  • Knowledge of control algorithms and embedded programming for circuit design verification.
  • Experience in power electronics design optimized for DFX requirements (manufacturability and testability).
  • Understanding of EMC requirements and CE certification relevant to motor controller design in control system applications.

Qualifications:

  • BSc, MSc, or PhD in electronics, automation, cybernetics, or a related engineering field.
  • 3-5 years of industrial experience in relevant power electronics development and industrialization.
  • Ability to approach complex problems structurally.
  • Open-minded, professional English proficiency, and adaptability to work in a multicultural environment.
  • Continuously raising standards, innovative, and solution oriented.
  • Interest in electronics is an additional advantage.

What We Offer:

  • Exciting global R&D environment.
  • Engaging tasks and work-life balance.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • State-of-the-art development environment.
  • Training and career development opportunities.
  • Comprehensive insurance and pension plans.

title: Recruitment Manager
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients. Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the role

Darkroom is seeking a dedicated and experienced Recruiting Manager to lead our talent acquisition team and strategy. You will be the crucial link between our senior leadership and the execution of our hiring plan, ensuring we attract and hire top talent efficiently and effectively to support Darkroom’s ambitious growth goals.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Team Leadership & Coordination: Coordinate the daily activities, priorities, and resources of the recruiting team (including Senior Recruiters, Recruiters, and Coordinators) to ensure alignment with company objectives and hiring targets.

  • Strategic Partnership (SPOC): Serve as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for Darkroom's senior leadership, providing regular updates, strategic insights, and recommendations on hiring status, market conditions, and talent pipeline health.

  • Hiring Plan Execution: Own the delivery of the overall hiring plan. Proactively ensure all open positions are filled in the right time, managing requisition load and balancing team efforts across various departments (e.g., Engineering, Product, G&A, Sales).

  • Process Optimization: Continuously evaluate and refine our end-to-end recruitment processes, tools, and systems to maximize efficiency, candidate experience, and hiring quality.

  • Data & Reporting: Develop and present key recruiting metrics, reports, and dashboards to senior leadership, leveraging data to drive decision-making and forecast hiring needs.

  • Vendor Management: Manage relationships with external recruiting agencies, sourcing partners, and vendors as needed.

  • Recruiter Development: Mentor, coach, and develop the recruiting team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, high performance, and deep business acumen.

Standard Requirements

  • Experience: A minimum of 5+ years of progressive experience in Talent Acquisition or Recruiting, with at least 2 years of experience managing, leading, or mentoring a team of recruiters.

  • Leadership: Proven ability to lead and motivate a high-performing recruiting team in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Communication: Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and articulate hiring strategy and data to executive-level stakeholders.

  • Strategic Mindset: Demonstrated experience in translating business objectives into tactical recruiting strategies and operational plans.

  • Process Acumen: Deep understanding of full-cycle recruiting, best practices, and the ability to implement effective sourcing, interviewing, and closing strategies.

  • System Knowledge: Proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) (e.g., Greenhouse, Lever) and experience using data visualization/reporting tools.

  • Compliance: Strong knowledge of employment laws and compliance regulations related to hiring.

Why Darkroom

Darkroom builds the future of how brands grow. As Recruitment Manager, you’ll support that mission — helping shape the company by ensuring we pick the right candidates that make us what we are. You’ll collaborate with world-class operators, creatives, and data minds to build the next generation of marketing excellence.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Work-Life Balance: We recognize that time away from work is essential for growth and well-being. Our generous paid time off policy ensures you have the time you need to maintain a healthy work-life balance and perform at your best.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona! For NYC and Lisbon applicants a hybrid model will be required.

  • Health & Wellness: Company‑sponsored medical, dental, and vision benefits with, so you can stay as healthy as can be.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

  • Work on continuous improvement initiatives, including benchmarks with other geos.

title: Recruitment Manager
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients. Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the role

Darkroom is seeking a dedicated and experienced Recruiting Manager to lead our talent acquisition team and strategy. You will be the crucial link between our senior leadership and the execution of our hiring plan, ensuring we attract and hire top talent efficiently and effectively to support Darkroom’s ambitious growth goals.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Team Leadership & Coordination: Coordinate the daily activities, priorities, and resources of the recruiting team (including Senior Recruiters, Recruiters, and Coordinators) to ensure alignment with company objectives and hiring targets.
  • Strategic Partnership (SPOC): Serve as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for Darkroom's senior leadership, providing regular updates, strategic insights, and recommendations on hiring status, market conditions, and talent pipeline health.
  • Hiring Plan Execution: Own the delivery of the overall hiring plan. Proactively ensure all open positions are filled in the right time, managing requisition load and balancing team efforts across various departments (e.g., Engineering, Product, G&A, Sales).
  • Process Optimization: Continuously evaluate and refine our end-to-end recruitment processes, tools, and systems to maximize efficiency, candidate experience, and hiring quality.
  • Data & Reporting: Develop and present key recruiting metrics, reports, and dashboards to senior leadership, leveraging data to drive decision-making and forecast hiring needs.
  • Vendor Management: Manage relationships with external recruiting agencies, sourcing partners, and vendors as needed.
  • Recruiter Development: Mentor, coach, and develop the recruiting team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, high performance, and deep business acumen.

Standard Requirements

  • Experience: A minimum of 5+ years of progressive experience in Talent Acquisition or Recruiting, with at least 2 years of experience managing, leading, or mentoring a team of recruiters.
  • Leadership: Proven ability to lead and motivate a high-performing recruiting team in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Communication: Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and articulate hiring strategy and data to executive-level stakeholders.
  • Strategic Mindset: Demonstrated experience in translating business objectives into tactical recruiting strategies and operational plans.
  • Process Acumen: Deep understanding of full-cycle recruiting, best practices, and the ability to implement effective sourcing, interviewing, and closing strategies.
  • System Knowledge: Proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) (e.g., Greenhouse, Lever) and experience using data visualization/reporting tools.
  • Compliance: Strong knowledge of employment laws and compliance regulations related to hiring.

Why Darkroom

Darkroom builds the future of how brands grow. As Recruitment Manager, you’ll support that mission — helping shape the company by ensuring we pick the right candidates that make us what we are. You’ll collaborate with world-class operators, creatives, and data minds to build the next generation of marketing excellence.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Work-Life Balance: We recognize that time away from work is essential for growth and well-being. Our generous paid time off policy ensures you have the time you need to maintain a healthy work-life balance and perform at your best.
  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona! For NYC and Lisbon applicants a Hybrid model will be required.
  • Health & Wellness: Company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision benefits with, so you can stay as healthy as can be.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

  • Experience with Zendesk.

Work Schedule

Unleash Your Full Potential at Nerdy

title: [2025] Talent Pool - XP Future | Rio de Janeiro
description:
(2025) Talent Pool - XP Future | Rio de Janeiro

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future - Rio de Janeiro, uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

  • Graduação superior completa ou estar cursando o último ano em período noturno;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente no Rio de Janeiro;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI)

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter uma alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.
  • Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Essa vaga é destinada a um pool de rede de talentos a nível Brasil, então pode ser que o retorno demore um pouco a mais do que outras vagas da XP! Em paralelo, também estão abertas as vagas dos XDays XP Future (vagas que acontecerão processos seletivos presenciais na cidade divulgada) para você se aplicar! Essas oportunidades se encontram aqui: Oportunidades XP Inc. ou

Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

Testes gerais : Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

Entrevista com a liderança : Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

Entrevista com Head Comercial : Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação.

Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Por fim, abaixo segue o vídeo sobre o Fator XP! Para você se reconhecer cada vez mais no nosso propósito como empresa e cultura:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

Main responsibilities

title: IT Project Manager (SAP S4 Service)
description:
Project Manager – SAP S4 Service

Introduction

Are you passionate about driving digital transformation in field service operations in a global environment? Do you have excellent technical skills—especially with SAP ECC CS and ideally SAP S/4HANA Service? We are seeking a hands-on Implementation Manager with deep SAP expertise to lead and deliver projects as part of our Global Technical Operations Team. Join us and shape our field service ecosystem, optimizing business processes, and ensuring technical excellence across our organization.

Your Responsibilities

  • Project Leadership: Independently manage and deliver complex implementation projects for our SAP-integrated Field Service Management system—from requirements engineering and solution design to Go-Live.
  • Technical System Configuration & Assessment: Utilize your expertise in SAP ECC CS and S/4HANA Service to evaluate available configuration options, enhancement frameworks (e.g., ABAP, User Exits, BADIs, RICEFW), and integration touchpoints with external Field Service Management platforms. Collaborate with IT and development teams to translate functional needs into robust technical system configurations, while adhering to established system capabilities and governance frameworks ensuring optimal alignment with business requirements and technical standards.
  • Interface & Integration Management: Analyze, design, and optimize interfaces between SAP modules (ECC CS, SD, S/4HANA Service) and third-party applications, ensuring robust system communication and data flows (IDOCs).
  • Process Optimization: Analyze and document business processes and technical workflows, focusing on automation, data quality, and system efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Management: Collaborate closely with both business and IT stakeholders, translating business requirements into technical solutions and acting as a technical consultant and change manager.
  • Data Quality & Business Intelligence: Develop, maintain, and optimize reporting solutions and analytics, ensuring high data consistency and reliability.
  • Training & Support: Deliver technical trainings, create documentation, and provide expert support to users and project teams.
  • Lifecycle Management: Support application lifecycle including 2nd level support.

Your Profile

  • 4-6 years of hands‑on experience with SAP ECC CS module and ideally SAP S/4HANA Service, including Customizing, technical configuration, and enhancement technologies (e.g., ABAP, BADIs, User Exits).
  • Deep understanding of SAP integration concepts (IDoc, RFC, Web Services, APIs) and experience in connecting SAP with external systems.
  • Proven track record in technical project management especially in IT/business process implementation projects.
  • Strong experience in interface design, data modelling, and system troubleshooting.
  • High attention to detail and passion for data quality.

Additional Skills

  • Hands‑on mentality, high IT affinity and willingness to learn about new IT systems, especially in the field of cloud and mobile applications.
  • Assertive and confident in technical discussions and decision‑making.
  • Team player with excellent collaboration and communication skills.
  • Willingness to travel internationally, as required.
  • Knowledge in SQL, SAP Field Service Management and Jira considered as a plus.
  • Fluent in English (Spanish is a plus).

Education

  • University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Informatics, or a related discipline; or equivalent professional experience.

Our Offer

There is a lot for you to discover at Fresenius Medical Care, because we have a lot to offer. No matter in which field you are an expert and how much experience you bring with you - for your professional future with meaning:

  • The opportunity to shape the future of healthcare innovation at a global market leader.
  • A highly collaborative, mission‑driven, and innovative culture.
  • Global exposure, challenging assignments, and high visibility.
  • A platform to make a tangible impact in advancing health, sustainability, and innovation.

At Fresenius Medical Care , we are the global leader in kidney care, committed to improving the lives of patients with chronic kidney disease. Our mission is to deliver high‑quality, innovative products, services, and care across the entire healthcare journey. Guided by our vision —“ Creating a future worth living . For patients. Worldwide. Every day.”—we work with purpose and compassion, supported by a global team of over 125,000 employees.

Within our Care Enablement segment, we develop and provide life‑sustaining medical products, digital health solutions, and therapies that empower clinical teams and improve patient outcomes. Our FME Reignite strategy drives transformation through innovation, efficiency, and sustainable growth.

Our values guide how we work:

  • We Care for our patients, each other, and our communities
  • We Connect across teams and borders to deliver excellence together
  • We Commit to doing things the right way— growing with purpose and leading kidney care with integrity and innovation

The Customer Support Specialist plays a critical role in ensuring a seamless learning experience by providing comprehensive support to learners and families exclusively through digital channels. At Nerdy (NYSE: NRDY) – the company behind Varsity Tutors – we're redrawing the blueprint of learning. Our Live + AI™ platform fuses real‑time human expertise with proprietary generative‑AI systems, setting a new bar for measurable academic impact at global scale.

In an era where great employees can deliver 10‑times the leverage of the merely good, we back those who play to win. Fortune favors the bold. Join us.

How we compete

  • AI‑Native at every level – From the CEO to day‑one hires, everyone builds and ships with generative AI. If you're not wielding AI, you're not done.
  • Entrepreneurial velocity – Move at founder speed, prototype in hours, and measure in real user outcomes. Slow teams die.
  • Free‑market rigor – Ideas rise or fall on merit and results – no committees, no politics, no cap on upside.

  • Manage a high volume of inbound inquiries via SMS, live chat, and email within our learning platform (no phone support required).

  • Respond to and resolve issues quickly and accurately through written channels.

Resolve Technical and Account Issues:

  • Troubleshoot and resolve platform issues, account access challenges, billing and payment inquiries, and product‑related questions.

  • Find solutions for families regarding educational products, including 1‑on‑1 tutoring, online classes, and adaptive assessments.

Drive Quality and Process Improvement:

  • Keep accurate records of interactions in our CRM system, with proper follow‑ups as needed.
  • Identify recurring issues and suggest process or content improvements to reduce contact rates.
  • Actively implement feedback and coaching to improve support quality and efficiency.

Qualifications

  • Fluent English proficiency (spoken and written) with excellent written communication skills.
  • 2+ years of experience in chat, SMS, or email‑based customer support or help desk roles.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve customer issues in writing with clarity and professionalism.
  • High empathy and patience; capable of delivering support with a positive tone in digital interactions.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to work independently as a self‑starter.
  • Ability to multitask effectively, managing multiple conversations simultaneously.
  • Comfortable performing all job responsibilities on a laptop or computer.
  • Reliable high‑speed internet access (100 Mbps download, 25 Mbps upload) via wired ethernet connection (no Wi‑Fi, Satellite, or Cellular Hotspot/Internet).
  • A quiet work environment that promotes focus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional experience in recruiting, education, customer service, retail, or another fast‑paced environment.
  • An Associate's degree or higher.
  • Experience with Zendesk, Slack and AI Support Tools.

Work Schedule

  • Ability to work full‑time (40 hours per week).
  • Evenings, weekends, and holidays are required based on available shifts.
  • Operating day is from 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM CDT.

Unleash Your Full Potential at Nerdy

  • Competitive Opportunity: Market‑leading compensation ($12/hr USD), with performance‑driven growth opportunities and rewards based on results.
  • 100% Remote: Work from anywhere in your home country.
  • Flexible Time Away: Coordinate with your team for planned time off, keeping our global platform running seamlessly.

title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator
description:
At Maersk Supply Service, crewing is more than logistics—it’s about people. We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Coordinator who values openness, collaboration, and trust, and who wants to make a real impact on the lives of our offshore colleagues.

Who are we?

At MSS, we’re more than a marine solutions provider—we’re a team that cares about doing things right. Based in Rio de Janeiro, you’ll join a close-knit HR & Crewing team that thrives on collaboration and respect. We offer:

  • A flexible, energised work environment where ideas are valued.
  • A culture that celebrates diversity and teamwork—“we” comes before “I”.
  • The opportunity to shape the future of our operations and support the growth of new seafarers through our Cadet Programme.

This role is a unique blend of operational excellence and human connection. As a company, we are owned by A.P. Moller Holding, operating independently with the trust and empowerment to do what is right for us, while proudly bearing the Maersk name and values.

What you’ll do

Your mission is simple yet powerful: attract and engage the best maritime talent while ensuring our offshore colleagues feel valued and supported .

You’ll lead initiatives that go beyond filling positions—creating meaningful connections and building trust with candidates and stakeholders. From crafting employer branding to managing end-to-end recruitment, you’ll ensure every interaction reflects our values.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Drive talent attraction strategies aligned with business goals.
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of skilled professionals for offshore roles.
  • Lead the Cadet Programme, supporting the next generation of seafarers.
  • Act as a trusted partner to hiring managers, providing insights and guidance.
  • Champion diversity and inclusion in all recruitment activities and find the candidate with the cultural fit to the company.
  • Continuously improve processes to enhance candidate experience and efficiency.
  • Coordinate offshore recruitment, ensuring compliance with maritime regulations (MLC, STCW, NR-30, Petrobras).
  • Plan and conduct recruitment for key maritime positions: Captain, Chief Officer, Deck Officer, Chief Engineer, 2nd Engineer Officer, Electrician/ETO, Able Seafarers and Motormen, Cooks and Stewards, etc.
  • Monitor KPIs, report results, and propose improvements.
  • Ensure that candidate records, certifications, and technical documentation are updated and accurate.
  • Support audits and collaborate with Payroll, Training & Compliance, and Vessel Operations.
  • Manage onboarding/offboarding and participate in the Crewing Duty Phone rotation.

Operational excellence will underpin your work—maintaining accurate candidate data, ensuring compliance with maritime regulations, and collaborating across HR, Payroll, Training, and Vessel Operations teams. You’ll also contribute to shaping the future of our talent strategy through innovative ideas and quality-driven initiatives.

Who you are

First and foremost, you are passionate about the maritime industry and enjoy building trusted relationships, and you recognize the game‑changing potential by working in crewing and the positive effect that you can bring to people’s life. In addition, we hope you can say yes to the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, HR, or related field.
  • 5+ years’ experience in offshore recruitment.
  • Proficiency in verbal and written English and Portuguese.
  • Knowledge of maritime regulations (MLC, STCW, NR-30, NORMAM).
  • Proven previous experience conducting recruitment processes for maritime positions.
  • Skilled in recruitment platforms and advanced Excel.
  • Strategic mindset, strong networking skills, and ability to work independently.
  • Passion for the maritime industry and commitment to diversity and inclusion.
  • Strong decision‑making, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Experience in lean organisations and proactive process improvement.
  • Makes quality decisions quickly and confidently, even in fast‑paced environments.

How to Apply

If you can imagine yourself in this role, we look forward to hearing from you. Please apply through our website no later than 30 November 2025. We will review and interview on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

Procuramos 2 economistas para construir o cérebro analítico da operação. Você vai trabalhar diretamente com o CEO / CTO em projetos que definem como alocamos capital, precificamos ativos e escalamos o negócio :

Projetos reais que você vai tocar :

Inteligência de Mercado & Performance
