Análise Econômico-Financeira

  • Valuation de portfólios e análise de oportunidades de aquisição
  • Modelagem DCF para investimentos em studios e conversões
  • ROI de reformas e CapEx por tipologia de imóvel
  • Análise de custos operacionais e otimização de margem

Suporte Estratégico

  • Apoio em decisões de alocação de capital (comprar x reformar x operar)
  • Análise de viabilidade econômica de novos projetos
  • Identificação de gargalos operacionais e oportunidades de eficiência

Quem Buscamos

  • Formação : Economia (essencial) - cursando a partir do 4º período ou recém-formado

O que você precisa ter :

  • Raciocínio quantitativo forte - você vê padrões em dados, não só números
  • Excel avançado - tabelas dinâmicas, funções complexas, modelagem financeira
  • Comunicação clara - transforma análise em insight acionável (oral e escrito )
  • Autonomia executiva - não espera task list, vai atrás do problema
  • Resiliência analítica - lida com dados bagunçados, premissas incertas, pivots rápidos

Diferenciais que amamos :

  • Python / R para análise de dados
  • Power BI, Looker ou ferramentas de visualização
  • Conhecimento de real estate, hospitalidade ou marketplace
  • Experiência com modelagem estatística (regressões, forecasting)
  • Habilidade em redação técnica e storytelling com dados

O que realmente importa :

  • Você pensa em sistemas, não em planilhas - entende que cada decisão afeta múltiplas variáveis
  • Executa rápido, itera mais rápido - prefere testar 80% correto hoje do que 100% perfeito nunca
  • Faz perguntas difíceis - questiona premissas, aponta riscos, propõe alternativas
  • Ownership total - trata o problema como seu, vai fundo até entregar solução
  • Escreve bem - sabe como contar uma história com dados para audiências diferentes

Mas o valor real está aqui :

  • Acesso direto ao CEO e decisões estratégicas da empresa
  • Projetos de impacto imediato - suas análises viram decisões de milhões em semanas
  • Experiência em Relações com Investidores - você vai escrever para e interagir com investidores reais
  • Curva de aprendizado vertical - hospitalidade + real estate + revenue management + finanças estruturadas
  • Portfólio real de trabalho - em 6 meses você tem cases concretos para qualquer entrevista futura
  • Ponte para ecossistema - Lobie faz parte do grupo HausBank (tokenização, DeFi, mercado de capitais)

Como se Candidatar

Envie para ( ; ) com assunto "Economista - Lobie" :

1. CV objetivo (máx. 1 página) 2. Mini-caso (escolha 1) :

Opção A - Informe ao Investidor :

Você precisa escrever um informe mensal para investidores da Lobie. No mês, a ocupação caiu de 82% para 78%, mas a receita subiu 5%. Como você estruturaria esse comunicado para explicar o resultado de forma clara e estratégica? (Máx. 300 palavras)

Opção B - Decisão de Investimento :

Lobie tem R$ 5M para alocar. Opção 1 : Comprar 20 studios prontos (yield 7%, gestão simples). Opção 2 : Comprar 8 aptos grandes para converter em 32 studios (yield projetado 9%, mas exige reforma de 6 meses e R$ 800k). Como você estruturaria a análise dessa decisão?

Sobre Meritocracia

Valorizamos diversidade de trajetórias. Se você tem perfil analítico forte mas não marca todos os requisitos técnicos, candidate-se mesmo assim . Preferimos alto potencial e fome de aprender a currículo impecável.

Não contratamos por pedigree de faculdade - contratamos por capacidade de resolver problemas complexos.

Por que trabalhar na Lobie?

Não somos uma startup "hypada". Somos uma operação real, lucrativa, em escala, resolvendo problemas complexos de otimização econômica no mundo físico. Se você quer entender como decisões analíticas viram resultado concreto (ocupação, receita, margem) e como comunicar isso para investidores sofisticados , esse é o lugar.

Position within the Talent Acquisition department at Howard University. The Senior Budget Officer is responsible for a portion of the university’s operating budget, collaborating with schools, departments, and leadership to develop, monitor, analyze, and forecast budget data.

  • Knowledge of analytical budgetary accounting.

  • Strong oral and written communication in English.

  • High proficiency in statistical analysis, revenue forecasting, financial modeling, project modeling and business plan development.

description:
***Employment Modality (Brazil - EOR): This remote role will be classified as a long-term Employment Relationship (Relação de Emprego) under the Brazilian Consolidated Labor Laws (CLT) . The contract will be managed through a local Employer of Record (EOR) to ensure full compliance with all Brazilian labor laws, including benefits, mandatory contributions, and tenure.

About the job

Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS) powers the white‑label travel platforms for some of the world’s largest financial institutions and airlines. As our strategic partner portfolio expands, so too does the need for sophisticated technical expertise and dedicated relationship management.

We are seeking a high‑impact Technical Account Manager (TAM) to be a technical liaison for multiple strategic partners. This critical role acts as the connective architect, seamlessly integrating Product, Engineering, Supply, and Customer Experience teams to ensure every partner receives clear, consistent, and exceptionally reliable support for technical inquiries and strategic growth initiatives.

This is a hands‑on, results‑oriented position. You will use your diagnostic skills and analytical abilities to validate incoming issues, structure comprehensive problem reports, and coordinate effectively with engineering. Your main goal is to ensure that all technical escalations are complete, actionable, and correctly prioritized. You will also play a key part in defining and optimizing our global intake, triage, communication, and escalation frameworks, helping partners get timely resolutions while keeping internal teams focused and efficient.

In short, this role requires a blend of investigative curiosity, clear communication, strong organizational skills, and a process‑improvement mindset, applied across a dynamic portfolio of partners and parallel technical workstreams.

What would your day‑to‑day look like

Partner Engagement & Communication

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for multiple B2B partners, each with unique needs, priorities, and communication channels.
  • Translate partner inquiries into structured, actionable requests with complete context.
  • Provide clear updates, timelines, and expectations, ensuring partners feel supported and aligned.

Technical Triage & Analysis

  • Assess and validate reported issues before escalating to engineering, including reproduction steps, logs, context, severity assessment, and relevant data insights.
  • Investigate technical or data‑centric questions using internal tools, dashboards, and SQL; identify whether issues stem from configuration, supply content, product behavior, data quality, or true system defects.
  • Manage and prioritize requests across multiple partners simultaneously, balancing urgency, impact, and engineering bandwidth.

Process & Program Development

  • Improve intake workflows, templates, and triage mechanisms to create consistency across partners.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, supply, and Customer Experience teams to refine escalation paths, service expectations, and communication standards.
  • Contribute to playbooks, documentation, and partner‑facing resources to strengthen transparency and scale operational excellence.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Coordinate with a wide and diverse set of stakeholders, including product managers, engineers, supply specialists, Customer Experience teams, and external partner teams.
  • Maintain clear follow‑through, alignment, and ownership across parallel workstreams.
  • Advocate for partner needs while helping internal teams maintain focus and momentum.

An ideal candidate has

  • An excellent communicator who can build trust with partners and internal teams through clarity, consistency, and professionalism.
  • Comfortable operating across several partners at once, with strong prioritization, context‑switching, and organizational skills.
  • Adept at turning ambiguity into clarity and designing repeatable processes that scale.
  • Technically fluent, with experience interpreting logs, analyzing data, exploring APIs, and using monitoring tools to support issue investigation and triage.
  • Experienced in roles such as Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer, Technical Support Engineer, Product Specialist, or a similar hybrid technical‑customer role.
  • Strong judgment in evaluating issue severity, partner impact, and operational urgency.

Nice to Haves

  • Intermediate or advanced SQL skills; experience working with data analysis, BI tools, or large datasets (BigQuery experience is a plus).
  • Familiarity with API debugging, distributed systems, or SaaS platform operations.
  • Experience implementing or optimizing ticketing and triage systems (Zendesk, Jira Service Desk, Salesforce, etc.).
  • Background improving cross‑functional workflows or partner‑facing operations at scale.

Perks and benefits of working with us

  • Well‑funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre‑IPO equity packages.
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.
  • Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for EOR‑offered health, dental, life short‑term disability insurances with SulAmerica.
  • Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers.
  • Very generous parental leave.
  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work‑from‑home stipend.
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

More about Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world‑class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end‑to‑end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:

  • Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.
  • Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no‑questions‑asked resolutions.
  • Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.
  • Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co‑develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen‑Z and millennials travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

Empoderamos as pessoas: Somos proativos para solucionar problemas e buscar oportunidades, assumimos responsabilidade pelas atividades exercidas, sem transferi-la para outros.

Apoiar o coordenador na leitura e interpretação dos principais drivers de resultado, propondo planos de ação para otimização de margens e rentabilidade;

  • Visão de Mercado e Concorrência: Realizar análises comparativas com práticas de mercado, benchmark de indicadores de cobrança e tendências do setor educacional e financeiro. Apoiar o posicionamento estratégico da área frente à concorrência e ao ambiente macroeconômico.

Se você preza pela valorização humana, integridade, foco no cliente, superação de resultados, sustentabilidade, inovação em soluções em tudo o que faz, vem fazer parte do nosso time de gigantes.

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?

Oferecemos um ambiente em que todos são protagonistas e agentes de transformação. Temos um excelente clima organizacional com pessoas engajadas em entregar os melhores resultados, assim como grandes oportunidades de crescimento para você.

Vem conferir!

  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Cumprimentar os clientes de forma cortês e prestativa, ajudando a esclarecer dúvidas, fornecendo informações sobre produtos, incluindo dosagem, uso e possíveis efeitos colaterais.
  • Dispensação de Medicamentos: Dispensar medicamentos prescritos com precisão, seguindo os regulamentos e procedimentos da farmácia. Certificar-se de que os pacientes recebam as orientações adequadas sobre o uso de medicamentos.
  • Vendas e Registro de Vendas: Realizar vendas de produtos de venda livre e registrar as transações com precisão. Processar pagamentos em dinheiro, cartão de crédito ou outros métodos de pagamento aceitos pela farmácia.
  • Gestão de Estoque: Verificar regularmente o estoque de medicamentos e produtos, repor itens conforme necessário e garantir que os produtos estejam dentro do prazo de validade. Manter registros precisos de estoque.
  • Conhecimento de Produtos: Manter-se atualizado sobre os produtos disponíveis na farmácia, incluindo suas características, benefícios e possíveis interações medicamentosas.
  • Atendimento Telefônico: Atender chamadas telefônicas de forma profissional, responder a perguntas dos clientes.
  • Organização: Manter a área de atendimento ao cliente e as prateleiras organizadas. Garantir que produtos perigosos sejam armazenados adequadamente e de acordo com as normas de segurança.
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Conhecimento em Informática Básica;
  • Desejável experiência como operador de caixa e atendimento ao cliente.

  • Experiência como operador de caixa e atendimento ao cliente.

  • Universidade Corporativa Pague Menos com cursos e treinamentos - Up Farma;
  • Desconto Ouro nas Farmácias Pague Menos;
  • Convênio Farmácia, com desconto em folha de pagamento - Epharma;

Não fazemos distinção de cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade.

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana , da superação de resultados , do foco no cliente , da sustentabilidade , da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore. Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde . Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos.

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .

Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante! Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.

Conheça os sabores dos deliciosos restaurantes e bares de Copacabana enquanto aprecia cada momento da viagem em um dos bairros mais famosos da zona sul do Rio de Janeiro, conhecido por suas ruas boêmias e poéticas, que até hoje servem de inspiração para os mais diversos artistas criarem suas músicas, livros e poesias.

Na hora de decidir o que fazer no Rio de Janeiro, lembre-se de incluir no roteiro o Museu do Amanhã, a lagoa Rodrigo de Freitas e o Museu de Arte Moderna. Usufrua de toda a riqueza e graciosidade da região e eternize a cidade maravilhosa dentro de você!

A Filadd é uma edtech internacional presente no cotidiano de mais de ********* estudantes no Brasil, Argentina, Colômbia e Chile, auxiliando na preparação para o ENEM e vestibulares.

Valores e Cultura

  • Visão inclusiva da Educação.

  • Familiaridade com tecnologias digitais e de trabalho remoto.
  • Respeito, gentileza e cordialidade sempre, para com todas as pessoas.

Encouraging Diversity

Encorajamos fortemente a candidatura de pessoas LGBTQIAPN+ e de pessoas pretas, pardas e indígenas. Respeito e acolhimento a todas as diversidades fundamentam os nossos valores.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Minimo de 2 anos de experiência no Pré-Vestibular como professora | professor | plantonista de Redação ou como pessoa corretora de Redação nos modelos ENEM e Vestibulares Estaduais.
  • Disponibilidade de 4 horas ou mais, por dia, de segunda a sexta.
  • Graduação em Letras.
  • Identificação com o perfil da Equipe Filadd.
  • Familiaridade com as ferramentas de trabalho do Google Workspace.
  • Boa comunicação e domínio da Língua Portuguesa, na escrita e na oralidade.
  • Conhecimento sobre o ENEM, os Vestibulares e as Universidades brasileiras.
  • Serão diferenciais: Experiências de correção junto a bancas oficiais de Vestibulares.
  • Conhecimentos em Metodologias de Aprendizagem Ativa e Educação Socioemocional.
  • Conhecimentos sobre a Linguagem Inclusiva.
  • Cursos de pós-graduação e outras formações em Educação.

O que esperamos para esta posição

Estudantes da Filadd contam com um acompanhamento individual por parte da Equipe de Redação, no desenvolvimento de sua autoria e autonomia na escrita de acordo com a nossa abordagem metodológica, para que possam escrever qualquer tipo de texto para as bancas do ENEM e Vestibulares sem que dependam de modelos prontos de redação. Para isto, oferecemos os serviços de Mentoria de Redação e de Correção de Redação. Esta correção, diferente das correções de banca, é uma correção pedagógica, com o objetivo de apontar com clareza ao estudante todos os aspectos que deve desenvolver no seu texto. Os dois serviços estão fundamentalmente conectados, partilhando o objetivo de desenvolver a escrita do estudante. Você integrará a equipe como pessoa Corretora de Redação, em contato constante com a Coordenação Pedagógica do curso. O trabalho será realizado de forma 100% remota, com jornada flexível segundo os horários que você disponibilizar. A contratação será via PJ, com remuneração de acordo com as horas trabalhadas e proposta de bônus por produtividade em relação às suas entregas.

Como se candidatar

  • Enviar currículo para ******.
  • Não será aceita somente a candidatura simplificada via Lattes.
  • Envie necessariamente por e‑mail.
  • Coloque no assunto: Processo Seletivo - Equipe Correção de Redação .
  • Inclua no corpo do texto a sua disponibilidade semanal.

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Join to apply for the Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing role at Go! Running Tours.

Hi… My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast-paced, bullet-pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let's start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that – if you are a runner and marketeer – probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban. You'll be working on a newsletter and pling! An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors. Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it! Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more...right? I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it. I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You'll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don't throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You'll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we'll back you while you do). You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that 'makes sense' to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;-)). My guess is that if you are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies! We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you're never left alone in any way. We're just on the other side of the world. The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The money should not be the main motivation for you – running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast-moving, and positive company should. The Contract Details Are As Follows: USD 1,400 a month. 25 hrs a week. Managed via Upwork. Oh, and hey… if you're considering this role as an add-on to an already existing full-time job, then hold your horses. I don't believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it. The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don't execute, we can't move the needle. That's it, I think. I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me via (contact) with a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please – we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version). Thanks for reading this far, Lena. Note: we usually take down our job posts within 3-4 days as we receive many applicants.

  • You'll be working on a newsletter and pling! The newsletter covers new events, sponsorships, and upcoming tours. Optimize flows and automate email sequences.

title: General Manager
description:
Overview

Fairmont Hotels is a globally renowned luxury brand, celebrated for creating unforgettable memories for our guests. With more than 30,000 colleagues worldwide, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional service, embracing innovation, and fostering a culture of excellence.

Hotel Overview

Perched on the world-famous Copacabana Beach, the Fairmont Copacabana is one of Rio de Janeiro’s most prestigious luxury addresses and a symbol of the city’s glamorous lifestyle. With 375 rooms and suites, many offering panoramic views of the ocean and Sugar Loaf Mountain, the hotel blends timeless elegance with the vibrant energy of Rio.

As a leading destination for both leisure and business travelers, the hotel boasts extensive meeting and event spaces, hosting everything from high-profile international conferences to glamorous weddings and social gatherings. With its enviable beachfront location, modern design infused with local culture, and a legacy of warm Brazilian hospitality, the Fairmont Copacabana embodies the art de vivre of Fairmont while standing as an icon of Rio de Janeiro’s luxury hotel scene.

Job Description

As the General Manager of Fairmont Copacabana , you will embody the essence of luxury hospitality. Your dynamic and hands-on approach is fueled by a deep passion for developing people and fostering an entrepreneurial spirit. A true brand and guest ambassador, you will challenge conventions, consistently seek solutions, and infuse innovation into every facet of the hotel experience and every function of the business.

Your seasoned leadership style will blend diplomacy with relationship-building prowess, cultivating strong connections with both internal and external stakeholders, including Owners and the Community. Your ability to engage with ownership and strategize revenue enhancements will be coupled with an innate talent for envisioning the hotel's long-term trajectory.

A refined sense of finance and business acumen will be at the core of your decision-making, grounded in an unwavering commitment to delivering a world-class product and service. By seamlessly weaving local heritage and culture into our offerings, you will not only create an authentic guest experience but also drive excellence across all dimensions of our operations.

In your role as a catalyst for exceptional service, you will uphold the highest standards, infusing every interaction with the kind of genuine care that leaves an indelible mark on our guests. Nurturing an environment of continuous growth and skill development, you will inspire our colleagues to consistently exceed expectations, turning moments into memories for every visitor.

As a visionary leader, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our strategic direction. Your involvement in goal setting and objective communication will propel business growth and solidify the hotel’s reputation as a distinguished luxury destination. Your ability to foster positive relationships with ownership will ensure a harmonious partnership that aligns with our overarching strategy while enhancing the hotel's performance and prestige.

Your leadership will be synonymous with setting industry benchmarks and redefining luxury hospitality. Your commitment to excellence, coupled with your innovative approach, will leave an enduring mark on our iconic brand and create a legacy of unparalleled guest memories.

Reporting Structure

The General Manager of Fairmont Copacabana will report to the Cluster Delegate Manager for Rio de Janeiro Luxury Hotels , as part of the unique cluster structure that unites Accor’s flagship luxury properties in the city.

Qualifications

Key Behaviours and Responsibilities:

  1. 1. Act with an open mindset:
    • Embrace innovative ideas, adapt to change, and encourage a culture of innovation and continuous learning.
    • Demonstrate explicit knowledge and awareness of company standards as an integral role model.
    • Build quality relationships with the management team.
    • Create an environment that encourages innovation, challenges traditional thinking, and fosters a "speak-up" culture.
  2. 2. Create positive impact working with others:
    • Foster an inclusive and collaborative work environment, empowering colleagues to contribute their best and building strong relationships based on trust and respect.
    • Create a collaborative and inclusive environment where all colleagues are encouraged to provide input.
    • Actively listen to team members' ideas, concerns, and feedback and incorporate their input into decision-making processes.
    • Recognize and appreciate the contributions and well-being of colleagues.
  3. 3. Strive for guest/client satisfaction:
    • Exhibits a deep understanding of the luxury hospitality landscape and guest expectations, ensuring that the guest experience consistently exceeds industry standards.
    • Maintain product and service quality standards by conducting ongoing evaluations.
    • Handle VIP Guests and understand international protocols for government officials and royalty.
    • Monitor guest/client feedback, address concerns promptly, and implement improvements to optimize satisfaction.
  4. 4. Consistently deliver excellence:
    • Demonstrates a comprehensive understanding of ownership group's investment objectives and formulates strategic business plans that align with those objectives; ensuring preservation and maximization of the hotel’s assets.
    • Set high performance standards, lead by example, and drive a culture of continuous improvement and quality across all the hotel.
    • Exhibits expertise in sales, marketing, and revenue management, driving the hotel's performance in the luxury hospitality market.
    • Maximize financial performance, control costs, and execute marketing and operational activities that produce results meeting or exceeding the hotel's business plan.
    • Recognize and reward outstanding performance and celebrate achievements within the organization.
  5. 5. Enable team success:
    • Support the professional growth and development of colleagues through coaching, mentoring, and providing opportunities for learning.
    • Encourage individuals to take on challenging assignments and stretch their capabilities.
    • Provide regular feedback and guidance, recognizing achievements and offering constructive suggestions for improvement.
    • Create a safe and empowering environment where individuals feel comfortable taking risks, expressing their ideas, and learning from failures.
    • As applicable, brings experience in working with labor unions, maintaining constructive relationships and ensuring harmonious teamwork.
  6. 6. Create clarity:
    • Articulates a clear and comprehensive vision for the hotel, aligning goals and objectives with ownership group's investment strategy.
    • Effectively communicates organizational vision, goals, and expectations, fostering a shared sense of purpose and direction among team members.
    • Demonstrates adeptness in overseeing renovation projects, maintaining transparency and open communication throughout the process.
    • Addresses ambiguity and navigates complex situations with transparency, fostering an environment of clear direction and effective problem-solving.
  7. 7. Inspire for top performance:
    • Lead with passion and integrity, motivate and inspire others to achieve their best.
    • Market plans and ideas successfully, reducing key and complex ideas and messages to clear, memorable, and compelling statements.
    • Embodies an entrepreneurial spirit, inspiring innovative thinking and fostering a culture that encourages taking calculated risks.
    • Recognizes and rewards outstanding performance, cultivating an atmosphere of achievement and recognition.
    • Promotes continuous development and growth, offering resources and guidance to nurture professional skills and talents.
    • Champions a "speak-up" culture, creating an environment where diverse opinions are valued, and individual contributions are celebrated.
    • Convince others, negotiate, debate, and find win-win solutions.

Additional Information

Prior experience in a luxury hotel General Manager position, in large hotel(s) (mandatory)

Fluent in English and in Portuguese or Spanish (mandatory)

Experience in working in Latin America, preferably in Brazil (mandatory)

Proven track record of building a strong service, and quality culture

Strong people skills and a track record of fostering positive, inclusive, high-performing cultures.

Experience in managing owner relations.

Demonstrated leadership, organizational, and interpersonal skills.

Strategic thinker with excellent communication and presentation skills.

Displays a strong entrepreneurial spirit

Bottom-line oriented with a focus on quality guest service and team-building.

Creative and innovative mindset.

Ability to collaborate and work in a fast-paced environment.

Excellent sense of prioritization and time management.

Professional demeanor and strategic orientation.

Engaging, friendly, and charismatic with a natural ability to connect with guests.

Passionate about creating memorable experiences and turning moments into memories

description:
Job description

Nossa história resume bem o que somos: uma combinação entre nosso potencial e a dedicação de quem acredita que limites existem para serem superados.

Sabemos que para ganhar o jogo precisamos dos melhores talentos e estamos aqui para jogar a longo prazo. Por isso, procuramos pessoas que queiram evoluir continuamente e se desafiar a construir algo relevante para nossos clientes.

Foram a ambição e o trabalho dos nossos associados que nos trouxeram até aqui e que continuarão a nos levar adiante. Por isso, buscamos os melhores profissionais, que sejam obcecados por gerar resultados através do time, liderando uma equipe de alta performance.

Se identificou? Então venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Main responsibilities

Como Supervisor de Prevenção de Perdas, você fará:

  • Visitas em loja: responsável por realizar auditorias presenciais das rotinas e processos em um grupo específico de lojas, efetuando as correções e ajustes necessários para assegurar o controle e a redução de perdas e quebras nas localidades, conforme metas pré-estabelecidas.
  • Tratativa dos indicadores críticos: responsável por monitorar, através de painel de indicadores e imagens, as informações atreladas a perdas e quebras das lojas, identificando possíveis desvios e agindo proativamente para corrigi-los.
  • Investigação de fraudes e desvios: responsável por apurar fraudes, quebras de procedimentos e desvios de mercadorias nas lojas através do canal de denúncias, visitas em loja e análise do painel de indicadores.
  • Acompanhamento de inventário: Responsável por acompanhar a organização e preparo das lojas para a realização de inventários, diagnosticando os resultados e elaborando um plano de ação junto às lojas para melhorar esses resultados.
  • Acompanhamento dos resultados: responsável por realizar reuniões semanais, quinzenais e/ou mensais para atualizar e apresentar resultados, discutir estratégias, e treinar a equipe de prevenção e os associados das lojas nos procedimentos preventivos.
  • Atuação em sinistros: responsável por identificar e implementar ações para mitigar e reduzir ocorrências de sinistros em determinadas localidades, além de fornecer o suporte necessário à loja após um sinistro, garantindo a execução adequada do procedimento pós-sinistro e prevenindo possíveis reincidências.

Requirements and skills

Você deve ter os seguintes requisitos:

  • Graduação completa;
  • Domínio do pacote office – Intermediário/avançado;
  • Habilidade analítica e estratégica;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de negociação;
  • Perfil direcionado a resultados;
  • Senso de urgência;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

Será um diferencial se você possuir:

  • Conhecimento prévio em Prevenção de Perdas;
  • Vivência com Looker ou Power BI;
  • Conhecimento com sistemas de CFTV;
  • Vivência com SAP.

Local de Trabalho:

  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em Rio de Janeiro - RJ .

title: General Manager
description:
Overview

Fairmont Hotels is a globally renowned luxury brand, celebrated for creating unforgettable memories for our guests. With more than 30,000 colleagues worldwide, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional service, embracing innovation, and fostering a culture of excellence.

Hotel Overview

Perched on the world-famous Copacabana Beach, the Fairmont Copacabana is one of Rio de Janeiro’s most prestigious luxury addresses and a symbol of the city’s glamorous lifestyle. With 375 rooms and suites, many offering panoramic views of the ocean and Sugar Loaf Mountain, the hotel blends timeless elegance with the vibrant energy of Rio.

As a leading destination for both leisure and business travelers, the hotel boasts extensive meeting and event spaces, hosting everything from high-profile international conferences to glamorous weddings and social gatherings. With its enviable beachfront location, modern design infused with local culture, and a legacy of warm Brazilian hospitality, the Fairmont Copacabana embodies the art de vivre of Fairmont while standing as an icon of Rio de Janeiro’s luxury hotel scene.

Job Description

As the General Manager of Fairmont Copacabana , you will embody the essence of luxury hospitality. Your dynamic and hands-on approach is fueled by a deep passion for developing people and fostering an entrepreneurial spirit. A true brand and guest ambassador, you will challenge conventions, consistently seek solutions, and infuse innovation into every facet of the hotel experience and every function of the business.

Your seasoned leadership style will blend diplomacy with relationship-building prowess, cultivating strong connections with both internal and external stakeholders, including Owners and the Community. Your ability to engage with ownership and strategize revenue enhancements will be coupled with an innate talent for envisioning the hotel's long-term trajectory.

A refined sense of finance and business acumen will be at the core of your decision-making, grounded in an unwavering commitment to delivering a world-class product and service. By seamlessly weaving local heritage and culture into our offerings, you will not only create an authentic guest experience but also drive excellence across all dimensions of our operations.

In your role as a catalyst for exceptional service, you will uphold the highest standards, infusing every interaction with the kind of genuine care that leaves an indelible mark on our guests. Nurturing an environment of continuous growth and skill development, you will inspire our colleagues to consistently exceed expectations, turning moments into memories for every visitor.

As a visionary leader, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our strategic direction. Your involvement in goal setting and objective communication will propel business growth and solidify the hotel’s reputation as a distinguished luxury destination. Your ability to foster positive relationships with ownership will ensure a harmonious partnership that aligns with our overarching strategy while enhancing the hotel's performance and prestige.

Your leadership will be synonymous with setting industry benchmarks and redefining luxury hospitality. Your commitment to excellence, coupled with your innovative approach, will leave an enduring mark on our iconic brand and create a legacy of unparalleled guest memories.

Reporting Structure

The General Manager of Fairmont Copacabana will report to the Cluster Delegate Manager for Rio de Janeiro Luxury Hotels , as part of the unique cluster structure that unites Accor’s flagship luxury properties in the city.

Qualifications

Key Behaviours and Responsibilities:

  1. 1. Act with an open mindset:

    Embrace innovative ideas, adapt to change, and encourage a culture of innovation and continuous learning. Demonstrate explicit knowledge and awareness of company standards as an integral role model. Build quality relationships with the management team. Create an environment that encourages innovation, challenges traditional thinking, and fosters a "speak-up" culture.

  2. 2. Create positive impact working with others:

    Foster an inclusive and collaborative work environment, empowering colleagues to contribute their best and building strong relationships based on trust and respect. Create a collaborative and inclusive environment where all colleagues are encouraged to provide input. Actively listen to team members' ideas, concerns, and feedback and incorporate their input into decision-making processes. Recognize and appreciate the contributions and well-being of colleagues.

  3. 3. Strive for guest/client satisfaction:

    Exhibits a deep understanding of the luxury hospitality landscape and guest expectations, ensuring that the guest experience consistently exceeds industry standards. Maintain product and service quality standards by conducting ongoing evaluations. Handle VIP Guests and understand international protocols for government officials and royalty. Monitor guest/client feedback, address concerns promptly, and implement improvements to optimize satisfaction.

  4. 4. Consistently deliver excellence:

    Demonstrates a comprehensive understanding of ownership group's investment objectives and formulates strategic business plans that align with those objectives; ensuring preservation and maximization of the hotel’s assets. Set high performance standards, lead by example, and drive a culture of continuous improvement and quality across all the hotel. Exhibits expertise in sales, marketing, and revenue management, driving the hotel's performance in the luxury hospitality market. Maximize financial performance, control costs, and execute marketing and operational activities that produce results meeting or exceeding the hotel's business plan. Recognize and reward outstanding performance and celebrate achievements within the organization.

  5. 5. Enable team success:

    Support the professional growth and development of colleagues through coaching, mentoring, and providing opportunities for learning. Encourage individuals to take on challenging assignments and stretch their capabilities. Provide regular feedback and guidance, recognizing achievements and offering constructive suggestions for improvement. Create a safe and empowering environment where individuals feel comfortable taking risks, expressing their ideas, and learning from failures. As applicable, brings experience in working with labor unions, maintaining constructive relationships and ensuring harmonious teamwork.

  6. 6. Create clarity:

    Articulates a clear and comprehensive vision for the hotel, aligning goals and objectives with ownership group's investment strategy. Effectively communicates organizational vision, goals, and expectations, fostering a shared sense of purpose and direction among team members. Demonstrates adeptness in overseeing renovation projects, maintaining transparency and open communication throughout the process. Addresses ambiguity and navigates complex situations with transparency, fostering an environment of clear direction and effective problem-solving.

  7. 7. Inspire for top performance:

    Lead with passion and integrity, motivate and inspire others to achieve their best. Market plans and ideas successfully, reducing key and complex ideas and messages to clear, memorable, and compelling statements. Embodies an entrepreneurial spirit, inspiring innovative thinking and fostering a culture that encourages taking calculated risks. Recognizes and rewards outstanding performance, cultivating an atmosphere of achievement and recognition. Promotes continuous development and growth, offering resources and guidance to nurture professional skills and talents. Champions a "speak-up" culture, creating an environment where diverse opinions are valued, and individual contributions are celebrated. Convince others, negotiate, debate, and find win-win solutions.

Additional Information

Prior experience in a luxury hotel General Manager position, in large hotel(s) (mandatory)

Strong educational background with professional qualifications and a continuous learning mindset.

Fluent in English and in Portuguese or Spanish (mandatory)

Experience in working in Latin America, preferably in Brazil (mandatory)

Proven track record of building a strong service, and quality culture

Strong people skills and a track record of fostering positive, inclusive, high-performing cultures.

Experience in managing owner relations.

Demonstrated leadership, organizational, and interpersonal skills.

Strategic thinker with excellent communication and presentation skills.

Displays a strong entrepreneurial spirit

Bottom-line oriented with a focus on quality guest service and team-building.

Creative and innovative mindset.

Ability to collaborate and work in a fast-paced environment.

Excellent sense of prioritization and time management.

Professional demeanor and strategic orientation.

Engaging, friendly, and charismatic with a natural ability to connect with guests.

Passionate about creating memorable experiences and turning moments into memories

title: General Manager
description:
Overview

Fairmont Hotels is a globally renowned luxury brand, celebrated for creating unforgettable memories for our guests. With more than 30,000 colleagues worldwide, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional service, embracing innovation, and fostering a culture of excellence.

Hotel Overview

Perched on the world-famous Copacabana Beach, the Fairmont Copacabana is one of Rio de Janeiro’s most prestigious luxury addresses and a symbol of the city’s glamorous lifestyle. With 375 rooms and suites, many offering panoramic views of the ocean and Sugar Loaf Mountain, the hotel blends timeless elegance with the vibrant energy of Rio.

As a leading destination for both leisure and business travelers, the hotel boasts extensive meeting and event spaces, hosting everything from high-profile international conferences to glamorous weddings and social gatherings. With its enviable beachfront location, modern design infused with local culture, and a legacy of warm Brazilian hospitality, the Fairmont Copacabana embodies the art de vivre of Fairmont while standing as an icon of Rio de Janeiro’s luxury hotel scene.

Job Description

As the General Manager of Fairmont Copacabana , you will embody the essence of luxury hospitality. Your dynamic and hands-on approach is fueled by a deep passion for developing people and fostering an entrepreneurial spirit. A true brand and guest ambassador, you will challenge conventions, consistently seek solutions, and infuse innovation into every facet of the hotel experience and every function of the business.

Your seasoned leadership style will blend diplomacy with relationship-building prowess, cultivating strong connections with both internal and external stakeholders, including Owners and the Community. Your ability to engage with ownership and strategize revenue enhancements will be coupled with an innate talent for envisioning the hotel's long-term trajectory.

A refined sense of finance and business acumen will be at the core of your decision-making, grounded in an unwavering commitment to delivering a world-class product and service. By seamlessly weaving local heritage and culture into our offerings, you will not only create an authentic guest experience but also drive excellence across all dimensions of our operations.

In your role as a catalyst for exceptional service, you will uphold the highest standards, infusing every interaction with the kind of genuine care that leaves an indelible mark on our guests. Nurturing an environment of continuous growth and skill development, you will inspire our colleagues to consistently exceed expectations, turning moments into memories for every visitor.

As a visionary leader, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our strategic direction. Your involvement in goal setting and objective communication will propel business growth and solidify the hotel’s reputation as a distinguished luxury destination. Your ability to foster positive relationships with ownership will ensure a harmonious partnership that aligns with our overarching strategy while enhancing the hotel's performance and prestige.

Your leadership will be synonymous with setting industry benchmarks and redefining luxury hospitality. Your commitment to excellence, coupled with your innovative approach, will leave an enduring mark on our iconic brand and create a legacy of unparalleled guest memories.

Reporting Structure
The General Manager of Fairmont Copacabana will report to the Cluster Delegate Manager for Rio de Janeiro Luxury Hotels , as part of the unique cluster structure that unites Accor’s flagship luxury properties in the city.

Qualifications

Key Behaviours and Responsibilities:

  • 1. Act with an open mindset:
    Embrace innovative ideas, adapt to change, and encourage a culture of innovation and continuous learning. Demonstrate explicit knowledge and awareness of company standards as an integral role model. Build quality relationships with the management team. Create an environment that encourages innovation, challenges traditional thinking, and fosters a "speak-up" culture.
  • 2. Create positive impact working with others:
    Foster an inclusive and collaborative work environment, empowering colleagues to contribute their best and building strong relationships based on trust and respect. Create a collaborative and inclusive environment where all colleagues are encouraged to provide input. Actively listen to team members' ideas, concerns, and feedback and incorporate their input into decision-making processes. Recognize and appreciate the contributions and well-being of colleagues.
  • 3. Strive for guest/client satisfaction:
    Exhibits a deep understanding of the luxury hospitality landscape and guest expectations, ensuring that the guest experience consistently exceeds industry standards. Maintain product and service quality standards by conducting ongoing evaluations. Handle VIP Guests and understand international protocols for government officials and royalty. Monitor guest/client feedback, address concerns promptly, and implement improvements to optimize satisfaction.
  • 4. Consistently deliver excellence:
    Demonstrates a comprehensive understanding of ownership group's investment objectives and formulates strategic business plans that align with those objectives; ensuring preservation and maximization of the hotel’s assets. Set high performance standards, lead by example, and drive a culture of continuous improvement and quality across all the hotel. Exhibits expertise in sales, marketing, and revenue management, driving the hotel's performance in the luxury hospitality market. Maximize financial performance, control costs, and execute marketing and operational activities that produce results meeting or exceeding the hotel's business plan. Recognize and reward outstanding performance and celebrate achievements within the organization.
  • 5. Enable team success:
    Support the professional growth and development of colleagues through coaching, mentoring, and providing opportunities for learning. Encourage individuals to take on challenging assignments and stretch their capabilities. Provide regular feedback and guidance, recognizing achievements and offering constructive suggestions for improvement. Create a safe and empowering environment where individuals feel comfortable taking risks, expressing their ideas, and learning from failures. As applicable, brings experience in working with labor unions, maintaining constructive relationships and ensuring harmonious teamwork.
  • 6. Create clarity:
    Articulates a clear and comprehensive vision for the hotel, aligning goals and objectives with ownership group's investment strategy. Effectively communicates organizational vision, goals, and expectations, fostering a shared sense of purpose and direction among team members. Demonstrates adeptness in overseeing renovation projects, maintaining transparency and open communication throughout the process. Addresses ambiguity and navigates complex situations with transparency, fostering an environment of clear direction and effective problem-solving.
  • 7. Inspire for top performance:
    Lead with passion and integrity, motivate and inspire others to achieve their best. Market plans and ideas successfully, reducing key and complex ideas and messages to clear, memorable, and compelling statements. Embodies an entrepreneurial spirit, inspiring innovative thinking and fostering a culture that encourages taking calculated risks. Recognizes and rewards outstanding performance, cultivating an atmosphere of achievement and recognition. Promotes continuous development and growth, offering resources and guidance to nurture professional skills and talents. Champions a "speak-up" culture, creating an environment where diverse opinions are valued, and individual contributions are celebrated. Convince others, negotiate, debate, and find win-win solutions.

Additional Information

  • Prior experience in a luxury hotel General Manager position, in large hotel(s) (mandatory)
  • Strong educational background with professional qualifications and a continuous learning mindset.
  • Fluent in English and in Portuguese or Spanish (mandatory)
  • Experience in working in Latin America, preferably in Brazil (mandatory)
  • Proven track record of building a strong service, and quality culture
  • Strong people skills and a track record of fostering positive, inclusive, high-performing cultures.
  • Experience in managing owner relations.
  • Demonstrated leadership, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strategic thinker with excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Displays a strong entrepreneurial spirit
  • Bottom-line oriented with a focus on quality guest service and team-building.
  • Creative and innovative mindset.
  • Ability to collaborate and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent sense of prioritization and time management.
  • Professional demeanor and strategic orientation.
  • Engaging, friendly, and charismatic with a natural ability to connect with guests.
  • Passionate about creating memorable experiences and turning moments into memories

  • Excelente habilidade analítica e proficiência em Excel/Google Sheets.

Informações adicionais

  • Rigor e Organização: Extremo cuidado com a integridade dos dados de cadastro, preço, estoque e detalhes, essencial para evitar prejuízos operacionais.

description:
Sobre nós
Somos a equipe de Tech Strategy & Advisory da Accenture, referência global em como tecnologia e inovação reinventam negócios e promovem mais competitividade para qualquer empresa. Nossa missão é apoiar executivos de alto nível a trazer disrupção aos seus setores, aproveitando o poder da tecnologia para capturar market share.

A área de Tech Strategy combina conhecimento profundo de negócios e de domínios tecnológicos para ajudar nossos clientes a se tornarem mais competitivos, liberando valor e acelerando crescimento. Em um mundo marcado por transformações constantes, o C‑Suite precisa posicionar a tecnologia como diferencial estratégico, capaz de garantir agilidade e resiliência aos negócios. Novas arquiteturas de negócio e de tecnologia rompem com modelos tradicionais, criando a base necessária para competir e crescer nesse novo cenário.

A Accenture Tech Strategy & Advisory possibilita que líderes atuem com rapidez e confiança ao direcionar suas organizações para o futuro. Capacitamos organizações a reinventarem seus modelos de operação e crescimento, aplicando Inteligência Artificial Generativa e Agentes, plataformas avançadas de dados e analytics, automação inteligente e ciber‑resiliência – sempre com agilidade, escala e impacto tangível para o negócio.

O papel

Como Consultor/a de Technology Strategy & Advisory, você atuará diretamente nas transformações que envolvem tecnologia em nossos clientes, ajudando a definir visões ousadas e roadmaps práticos. Você ajudará nossos clientes a identificar oportunidades de valor, a estruturar business cases sólidos, a pensar na modernização de suas áreas de Digital/IT/OT e a definir modelos operacionais que integrem negócios e tecnologia.

Responsabilidades principais

  • Identificar, priorizar e estruturar oportunidades de criação de valor, por meio de análises profundas do ambiente tecnológico atual.
  • Elaborar modelos operacionais de TI (IT Operating Models), governança de TI, business cases, roadmaps de transformação e planos de modernização.
  • Participar de iniciativas ligadas a fusões e aquisições e otimização de custos/eficiência operacional.
  • Fomentar inovação: desenvolver pontos de vista sobre o uso de tecnologias emergentes (por exemplo, AI, Agentes, Cloud, IoT, Cyber Security, Analytics) para suportar transformações em escala.
  • Apoiar na comunicação executiva: apresentar recomendações, conceitos complexos e resultados de forma clara, impactante e orientada por dados.
  • Ajudar a desenvolver times multidisciplinares, facilitando workshops, estruturando trabalhos analíticos, promovendo colaboração entre áreas.

Qualificações exigidas

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas; idealmente com pós‑graduação ou MBA.
  • Pelo menos 2 a 4 anos de experiência em consultoria de estratégia ou função equivalente, com exposição a tecnologia + negócio.
  • Compreensão clara de conceitos relacionados a negócios e operação de modelos de TI, com roadmaps, business cases, modelagens financeiras e otimização operacional.
  • Habilidade analítica avançada, inclusive com uso de dados, visualização e storytelling executivo.
  • Forte comunicação, influência e relacionamento com stakeholders seniores.
  • Desejável conhecimento prático em tecnologias emergentes, incluindo fundamentos de Inteligência Artificial (Machine Learning, LLMs, GenAI) e uso de Agentes de AI para automação, tomada de decisão e orquestração de processos.

Diferenciais

  • Perfil pró‑ativo para inovação e pensamento crítico.
  • Participação em iniciativas de avaliação de custo completo / eficiência de TI.
  • Fluência em inglês (e preferivelmente outro idioma além do português).
  • Conhecimento profundo em um setor da indústria / serviços.
  • Vivência em projetos que envolvam aplicação de AI Generativa ou Agentes Inteligentes (por exemplo: copilotos, assistentes digitais, automação baseada em linguagem natural).
  • Capacidade de traduzir possibilidades técnicas de AI em oportunidades de negócio, integrando essas soluções em roadmaps estratégicos.

Benefícios que a Accenture oferece

  • Projetos globais
  • Plano de Carreira e Desenvolvimento

title: Software Developer
description:
Select how often (in days) to receive an alert:

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 20,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

The Senior Software Developper calls for an experienced, knowledgeable, and talented individual to design and develop software for the User Configurable Open System (UCOS) product.

As a senior software engineer, you will have an opportunity to apply your versatile embedded, systems, and application software development skills to UCOS’s expanding use in myriad industrial controls and automation systems and Industrial IoT.You will lead and collaborate with other engineers while contributing at all phases of the software development lifecycle.

Job Description

  • Architect, design, implement, test and deliver high quality, performant software products.
  • Work cross functionally with software, application, and quality engineers to ensure products meet engineering and client success criteria.
  • Actively participate in the definition and implementation of new processes and improvements
  • Identify and create new technologies and ideas to increase the organization’s intellectual property and to better address customer needs.
  • Present your designs and solutions to internal and external teams and review designs of software and quality engineers.
  • Develop test plans and test automation processes to increase automated functional tests.
  • Mentor team in development/test technologies, tools, and processes

You are meant for this job if:

  • Requires a Bachelor of Science degree or related
  • Expertise in software engineering
  • Expert experience in C/C++, developing embedded software and systems software
  • Deep knowledge of object-oriented programming and experience with at least one of (Java, C#, Python, Ruby)
  • Knowledge of containerization technologies (such as Docker), Kubernetes technologies (such K3S, Helm charts, Rancher), and IoT protocols (MQTT, REST API, Kafka)
  • Knowledge of cloud technologies such as AWS
  • Systems software programming knowledge of Windows and Linux OS
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft MFC (Microsoft Foundation Class), WPF, Qt, or similar GUI framework
  • Understanding of database technologies such as SQL, ODBC, and relational database schema design
  • Understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP), wired interfaces (Ethernet, USB), and wireless interfaces (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Cell, Satellite)
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining APIs for internal/external services
  • Exposure to the principals of Industrial Protocols, Platforms and APIs: OPC (DA & UA), Profibus, Profinet, Modbus (RTU, TCP, Enron), EtherIP, etc.
  • Exposure to serial communication protocols (I2C, RS-485, RS-232, CAN, SPI)
  • Exposure to industry standard embedded design and debugging tools is a plus (JTAG, protocol analyzers, emulators)
  • Exposure to Configuration Management tools (Version control, bug tracking, change management, automated builds, and coding standards)
  • Exposure to developing in agile and Iterative Software development processes
  • Excellent verbal and written communications skills

Skills

We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matters and we encourage you to add to our culture.

Vem fazer parte do Time IDG

Somos uma organização social privada sem fins lucrativos, especializada em gerir centros culturais públicos de grande importância para o país e programas ambientais. Atualmente, também prestamos consultorias para a concepção, modelagem, formatação e gestão de projetos, desenvolvendo o escopo, fazendo a captação de recursos, o enquadramento nas leis de incentivo e gerindo sua implementação.

O Paço do Frevo , localizado no coração do Recife, é mais do que um museu; é um guardião do patrimônio mundial da humanidade, celebrando a riqueza e a diversidade de nossa cultura.

O Museu do Amanhã , uma fascinante instituição de ciências no Rio de Janeiro, convida você a refletir sobre nossas ações presentes e seu impacto no amanhã, inspirando mudanças para um futuro melhor.

O Museu das Favelas em São Paulo é um espaço de resiliência e criatividade das comunidades, revelando a potência e o brilho das favelas através de suas histórias e expressões culturais únicas.

O Museu do Jardim Botânico do Rio de Janeiro é uma viagem encantadora pelo mundo da botânica, convidando você a explorar a beleza e a importância das plantas em nossas vidas.

O Programa de Formação Cultural CULTSP PRO - Escolas de Profissionais e de Empreendedores da Cultura, no Estado de São Paulo, oferece cursos em diversas áreas, incluindo Artes Cênicas, Audiovisual, Games, Moda, entre outras.

Sediado na cidade de Belém, o novo Museu das Amazônias , implementado pelo IDG em parceria com o Museu Paraense Emílio Goeldi, será uma referência na área de ciências e tecnologias. Com experiências imersivas e coletivas, irá reunir as muitas Amazônias, nacionais e internacionais, e aproximar os vários setores sociais para debater os temas da área.

Além dos museus, temos também a gestão do Fundo da Mata Atlântica e atuamos na revitalização do Cais do Valongo-RJ .

Nosso propósito é : Esperançar futuros possíveis

  • Criativos na essência: Acreditamos que a criatividade está no nosso DNA. Todos podemos praticá-la no dia a dia, seja na tarefa mais simples ou em projetos complexos;
  • Autenticamente diversos: Somos muitos, somos diferentes e cada vivência e visão de mundo importa. É da soma dessas diferenças que vêm as nossas melhores ideias;
  • Compromisso com excelência: Fazemos sempre o nosso melhor. Nos orgulhamos de estabelecer boas relações com nossos parceiros, colaboradores e todas as pessoas que estão na nossa rede, e de criar espaços encantadores de reflexão e conhecimento.
  • Respeito aos acordos: Entendemos que o respeito vai além da boa educação e deve ser a base no tratamento com qualquer um. Respeitamos os acordos e oferecemos segurança jurídica e financeira para construir laços de confiança.
  • Encantamento: Recebemos as pessoas com prazer e nos orgulhamos quando elas são maravilhadas pelos nossos espaços, seja no ambiente corporativo, seja nos museus. Incentivamos as pessoas a alcançarem o seu potencial e vivemos entusiasmados pelo nosso propósito.

Se você compartilha da nossa paixão por promover o acesso à cultura, preservar o meio ambiente e inspirar mudanças positivas, junte-se a nós! Estamos sempre em busca de mentes criativas e comprometidas para se juntar à nossa equipe e fazer a diferença.

Venha fazer parte dessa jornada conosco!

title: Página da Vaga | Analista de Dados Senior (Performance)
description:
Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados Sênior para promover análises aprofundadas e desenvolvimento de dashboards e modelos analíticos que suportem decisões críticas da organização, atuando com autonomia em projetos multidisciplinares e garantindo a qualidade e clareza dos insights para áreas estratégicas da empresa.

  • Desenvolver modelos analíticos e preditivos aplicando técnicas estatísticas e algoritmos de machine learning, com uso de Python, SQL e Power BI, para apoiar decisões estratégicas e resolver problemas complexos
  • Conduzir processos de ETL com autonomia, integrando dados de múltiplas fontes e assegurando consistência, confiabilidade e conformidade com padrões internos e externos
  • Projetar dashboards e relatórios interativos com foco em indicadores de desempenho e oportunidades de melhoria, utilizando Power BI e promovendo a clareza na comunicação dos insights
  • Implementar automações e soluções integradas com Power Automate e Power Apps, contribuindo para a eficiência dos processos e a redução de retrabalho nas áreas de negócio
  • Interagir com stakeholders para entender demandas analíticas, traduzindo necessidades em soluções técnicas robustas e alinhadas às boas práticas de segurança e privacidade de dados.
  • Formação acadêmica: Engenharia, Estatística, Ciência da Computação, Matemática ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em manipulação e análise de dados utilizando SQL, Python (bibliotecas como Pandas, NumPy, PySpark), e desejável conhecimento em R.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização (Power BI, Tableau ou similares).
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de Data Lakes , ETL/ELT e integração de dados em ambientes distribuídos.
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de estatística, modelagem preditiva e machine learning .
  • Capacidade comprovada de automação de processos e indicadores .
  • Conhecimento em APIs, integração de sistemas e orquestração de pipelines (Airflow, Prefect ou similares).
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação para apresentar resultados de forma clara e objetiva.
  • Proatividade, orientação para resultados e capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e colaborativa.
  • Desejável: conhecimento em regulamentações de privacidade (LGPD, GDPR) e práticas de segurança da informação.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com cloud computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Conhecimento em Big Data frameworks (Hadoop, Spark).
  • Vivência em projetos de governança de dados e qualidade de dados.

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space , o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.

Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Digital Product Lead
description:
Job Description

Help us lead the strategy, design, and delivery of innovative digital solutions to enhance efficiency, client satisfaction, and compliance in the global food TIC (Testing, Inspection & Certification) industry. We are looking for an experienced Product Lead to combine business acumen, technology expertise, food quality knowledge, and emerging technologies to build scalable, data‑driven products.

Key Missions

  • Product Strategy & Leadership Define a clear product vision, roadmap, and success criteria aligned with business goals and standards (e.g., GlobalG.A.P., BRCGS). Collaborate across functions to prioritize high‑value initiatives, leveraging AI and automation where relevant to improve outcomes.
  • Analysis & Solution Design Drive requirements gathering and process mapping; create detailed functional specs, user stories, and workflows. Design robust, scalable solutions adhering to enterprise architecture, data governance, and best practices for usability and performance.
  • Project Delivery Act as the main bridge between business, development, and QA teams. Manage agile projects from inception to release, ensuring accuracy, attention to detail, and effective resource planning.
  • Documentation & Governance Develop and maintain comprehensive, accessible product documentation.
  • Testing & Implementation Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and validation, incorporating rapid feedback loops. Support smooth rollouts, with a focus on adoption, data integrity, and long‑term product stability.
  • Field Engagement (GOOB) Engage directly with food audit operations: shadow audits, observe workflows, and capture user insights to ensure continuous improvement and strong local/global adoption.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related.
  • Experience: 6+ years in digital product management; strong track record in delivering large‑scale solutions; food TIC sector experience preferred.
  • Technical Skills: Agile (Scrum/Kanban), requirements elicitation, Figma/Miro, SQL, API design/integration, AI‑powered data analysis.
  • Languages: Fluent English & Portuguese; Spanish beneficial.
  • Soft Skills: Strategic thinker, exceptional attention to detail, analytical rigor, proactive problem‑solving, AI literacy, stakeholder engagement, leadership, adaptability, and high standards of quality.
  • Preferred: PMI‑PBA, CSPO or equivalent certifications; experience with GlobalG.A.P., BRCGS.

You Will Gain

Opportunity to lead digital transformation in food quality and compliance; collaborate with global experts; experience real‑world audits; grow within an innovative, mission‑driven, international organization.

    • Visualizar e programar ordens.
    • Atribuir status às ordens (ENTE, ENCE, LIB etc.).
    • Gerar relatórios de serviços de manutenção.

  • Programação de Manutenção:

    • Planejar ordens de manutenção rotineira e paradas programadas.
    • Solicitar e controlar recursos (andaimes, mão de obra, equipamentos).

    • Garantir disponibilidade de peças e materiais conforme reservas.
    • Acompanhar armazenagem e solicitações de materiais.

    • Desenvolver relatórios e apresentações (PowerPoint, ThinkCell).

  • Indicadores e Análise:

    • Controlar backlog e indicadores de manutenção (ex.: índice de execução).
    • Apoiar engenharia na análise de falhas e melhorias de processo.

  • Planejamento de Grandes Paradas (PGP):

    • Elaborar planejamento detalhado atendendo metas estabelecidas.
    • Liderar reuniões de cronograma e avaliação de paradas.

  • Desenvolvimento e Suporte:

    • Excel avançado (fórmulas, dashboards, VBA).
    • Power BI (indicadores e relatórios).
    • SAP PM e MM.
    • PowerPoint e ThinkCell para apresentações.

  • Metodologia 5S:
    Contribuir para práticas de organização, limpeza e padronização no ambiente de trabalho.

Competências Técnicas

  • Análise de materiais e contratos.
  • Gestão de estoque e modificações.
  • Análise de falhas e indicadores.
  • Domínio de ferramentas digitais (Excel avançado, Power BI, SAP PM/MM).

Experiência nas atividades descritas.
